input.quote: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
input.rationale: Section 20 contains only a one-way, unlimited Customer indemnity and no Vendor indemnity of any kind — walk-away territory — even though Section 9.3 cross-refers to infringement remedies under "Section 20.5" that do not exist. We added the Vendor IP/breach-of-law/data-breach/wilful-misconduct indemnity with standard procedure and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law.
